item.text: {"decision":"Create a reported focal event from D01 only and open narrowly scoped acquisition requests for retained motion, hydraulic, execution/isolation, and inspection evidence needed to separate occurrence, release mechanism, and upstream compliance questions. No causal mechanism is concluded; D02/D04 only define applicable behavior/configuration limits, and D15 is treated as an unreviewed interpretation rather than independent event evidence.","operations":[{"action":"create","expected_version":0,"replaces":null,"reason":"D01.S01 reports that at 13:24 on 14 October 2024 the R3 delivery carrier beam fell into the mill pit and struck the sled and scaffold platform, with no person struck, after the assembly had been parked raised following backup-roll removal during the outage. D01.S02 adds initial observations that the keeper plate was found bolted to the recovered assembly and that the beam/yoke were not reported fractured, but expressly says these are not a release-mechanism conclusion. D15.S01-S03 is not used as independent support because it is an unreviewed interpretation citing only the initial notice and handle status.","record":{"id":"N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall","kind":"node","scope_key":"r3_delivery_carrier_beam_fall_2024-10-14_1324","claim":"At 13:24 on 14 October 2024 the R3 delivery carrier beam fell into the mill pit and struck the sled and scaffold platform while the assembly was parked raised after backup-roll removal during the outage; no person was struck.","status":"reported","sources":["D01"],"depends_on":[],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}},{"action":"create","expected_version":0,"replaces":null,"reason":"D01.S03 says a motion record was retained, but its coverage/applicability has not been checked. D02.S04-S05 defines that yoke YK-3 follows support cylinder C17, relative withdrawal is yoke downward travel minus carrier downward travel, and at least 30 mm relative downward yoke withdrawal eliminates primary seating engagement; D02.S05 also states keeper bypass requires separate lateral-offset/dynamic-path evidence. This request can support, challenge, or leave inconclusive whether motion sufficient for unseating occurred and whether temporary interference affected carrier/yoke relative travel. Reopening condition after answer/block: a new or revised motion source with additional time-position channels, timing synchronization, or interference observations for the same event window.","record":{"id":"R_R3MotionRecord","kind":"request","scope_key":"r3_motion_record_2024-10-14_event_window","claim":"Obtain and assess retained motion evidence to determine yoke/carrier movement timing, relative withdrawal, and possible interference during the R3 beam fall event.","status":"proposed","sources":["D01","D02"],"depends_on":["N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":"R3 delivery carrier beam and CB-3/YK-3 raised assembly","window":"14 October 2024 outage, interval before and at 13:24 event","fields":["time-position trace for yoke YK-3 and carrier beam","relative vertical withdrawal calculation inputs","evidence of mill post or spreader interference timing"]}},{"action":"create","expected_version":0,"replaces":null,"reason":"D01.S03 says hydraulic records were retained, but coverage/applicability has not been checked. D02.S02-S03 defines the applicable C17/V17 support-fluid path and warns that V17 CLOSED limit-switch position does not measure seat leakage and that motor/pump isolation does not prove mechanical restraint or that trapped fluid cannot leave the chamber. This request can support, challenge, or leave inconclusive whether support-chamber fluid loss or an alternate return/leak path was operating at the incident time; it will not by itself prove the carrier fell because D02.S06 states a leaking valve alone is not specified as sufficient. Reopening condition after answer/block: new or revised hydraulic data for C17/V17, external leakage monitoring, or alternate return-path monitoring in the event window.","record":{"id":"R_R3HydraulicRecords","kind":"request","scope_key":"r3_c17_v17_hydraulic_records_2024-10-14_event_window","claim":"Obtain and assess retained hydraulic evidence for C17/V17 to determine support-chamber pressure/fluid retention, valve status, leakage, and alternate return-path conditions during the R3 raised-assembly event.","status":"proposed","sources":["D01","D02","D04"],"depends_on":["N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":"R3 CB-3/YK-3 raised balance assembly C17 support chamber and V17 return-isolation valve","window":"14 October 2024 outage, interval before and at 13:24 event","fields":["C17 support-chamber pressure or position-related hydraulic data","V17 handle or closed-limit status with timestamps","V17 seat-leakage or chamber-to-return leakage measurements","external leakage and alternate return-path monitoring","motor or pump supply isolation timing"]}},{"action":"create","expected_version":0,"replaces":null,"reason":"D01.S03 says the work package and isolation records were retained. D04.S01 states WP-031 calls for electrical supply isolation and hydraulic valve closure and contains no instruction to install a positive yoke block or verify the off-center carrier retention envelope. D04.S03 warns that a procedural omission is distinct from proof of what workers did, so execution records are needed to establish actual block presence/compliance and any authorization or reason for noncompliance. This request can support, challenge, or leave inconclusive actual restraint/isolation conditions and procedure execution; it does not establish organizational cause by itself. Reopening condition after answer/block: new completed forms, permits, witness records, or authorization records covering WP-031 execution for this outage.","record":{"id":"R_R3ExecutionIsolation","kind":"request","scope_key":"r3_wp031_execution_isolation_records_2024-10-14","claim":"Obtain and assess work-package execution and isolation evidence to determine actual restraint, isolation, authorization, and compliance conditions for WP-031 during the R3 event.","status":"proposed","sources":["D01","D04"],"depends_on":["N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":"R3 raised balance assembly during WP-031 stripper-box changeout","window":"14 October 2024 outage before and at 13:24 event","fields":["completed WP-031 steps and signoffs","actual positive yoke block presence or absence","electrical supply isolation records and timing","hydraulic valve closure or isolation records and timing","authorization and reason for any omitted restraint or retention-envelope verification"]}},{"action":"create","expected_version":0,"replaces":null,"reason":"D01.S03 says inspection photographs were retained. D01.S02 reports only initial observations that the keeper plate was found bolted to the recovered assembly and beam/yoke were not reported fractured; it expressly does not conclude the release mechanism. D02.S05 states primary seating loss and keeper engagement are separate questions, with keeper engagement depending on lateral offset and dynamic path. This request can support, challenge, or leave inconclusive whether fracture, deformation, keeper geometry, seating condition, or lateral offset contributed. Reopening condition after answer/block: new photographs, measurements, or preservation records of the recovered assembly, yoke, keeper, sled/scaffold impact area, or mill-post/spreader contact surfaces.","record":{"id":"R_R3InspectionPhotos","kind":"request","scope_key":"r3_recovered_assembly_inspection_photos_measurements_2024-10-14","claim":"Obtain and assess inspection photographs and measurements to document recovered component condition, keeper/seating geometry, lateral offset indicators, and impact/contact evidence relevant to the R3 beam release path.","status":"proposed","sources":["D01","D02"],"depends_on":["N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":"R3 recovered carrier beam, yoke YK-3, keeper plate, sled, scaffold, and adjacent mill-post/spreader contact areas","window":"post-event recovery/inspection following 13:24 event on 14 October 2024, with preservation history if available","fields":["keeper plate condition and fastener state","beam and yoke fracture or deformation evidence","primary seating engagement or wear/contact measurements","lateral offset indicators and dynamic path alternatives.","target_ids":["N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall"]},{"kind":"specialist","tag":"hydraulics","focus":"Using D02/D04 nomenclature, identify the C17/V17 hydraulic conditions required for downward yoke travel and specify how retained hydraulic records could support or challenge chamber-fluid loss versus other paths.","target_ids":["N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall"]},{"kind":"specialist","tag":"work_control_upstream","focus":"Review D04 limits and forthcoming execution/isolation evidence to separate procedure requirements, actual compliance, authorization, and reasons for any missing positive restraint or retention-envelope verification.","target_ids":["N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall"]}],"upstream_dispositions":[],"disposition":"continue"}
